items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I knew her as a kid, as I told you, I used stare and look in the window for her.

ctx.x: And then we had such singers as Mary Stafford, worked with Madison Reed and with Eubie Blake. She was one of the greatest. You could hear her four or five blocks away, yelling, when she would sing. I knew her as a kid, as I told you, I used stare and look in the window for her. And I had the nerve to fall in love with her when I was a kid. You see?
